relations.subject: capella-role:organization-member
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused (disablesFeatureFor) - repurposed here for a role-based (not auth-method-based) capability restriction; flagged as a possible predicate-family split for reconciliation (auth-method-driven vs role-driven disabling)
relations.evidence: For example, if a user has the [Organization Member](organization-user-roles.md#organization-role-member) role, they cannot manage API keys or view billing information in the Capella UI.

relations.subject: capella:project
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused (requiresCapellaRole) - object is a project role, showing requiresCapellaRole's object range spans both organization- and project-level roles
relations.evidence: For example, if a user only has the [Cluster Manager](../projects/project-roles.md#project-cluster-manager-role) project role, they cannot use the **Data Tools** tab to access and modify data for clusters in that project.

relations.subject: capella:project
relations.evidence: If that same user had the [Data Writer](../projects/project-roles.md#project-cluster-data-reader-writer) project role in the same project, they could use the **Data Tools** tab to access and modify data on clusters in that project.

relations.subject: capella:project
relations.evidence: Only the [Project Owner](../projects/project-roles.md#project-owner-role) role can create cluster access credentials for their projects.

relations.subject: capella:project
relations.evidence: Capella offers [basic access credentials](../clusters/cluster-rbac.md#basic-access-credentials) with predefined read, write, or read/write permissions, and [advanced access credentials](../clusters/cluster-rbac.md#advanced-access-credentials) with fine-grained privileges and reusable access roles for more precise access control.

notable_absence.finding: No Enterprise/Community edition badges anywhere on this page, consistent with the batch background (Capella has no EE/CE distinction) - the only gating axes present are capella-role:* (organization/project roles) and cluster-access-credential-type (Basic/Advanced), never edition.

cross_component_finding: This page is the strongest evidence in the batch that the organization-level and project-level role catalogs are siblings, not the same list: capella-role:organization-owner/project-creator/organization-member (from organization-user-roles.md) control Capella UI features (billing, API keys, project creation), while a separate, only-linked-not-read project-roles.md catalog controls per-cluster data/administration actions and already includes at least 'Cluster Manager' and 'Data Writer' (= Project Data Writer) beyond the project-owner/project-data-writer pair the capella-role:* catalog previously had. The reconciler should treat project-roles.md as needing its own extraction pass - this page confirms it has more named roles than the two currently promoted (project-owner, project-data-writer).
cross_product_finding: Cluster access credentials (Basic/Advanced) remain the data-plane axis, orthogonal to both organization and project roles - this page states explicitly that only Project Owner can even create these credentials, so the two axes (who can create a credential vs. what the credential itself can do) stack rather than substitute for each other, consistent with server/'s and cloud/'s prior privilege-catalog findings.
